question:
What should come in place of '?' in the given series?

11 39 123 375 1131 ?
solution: The logic followed here is: Each number in the series is obtained by multiplying the previous number by 3 and then adding 6. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cff39b6913eb4e4f33c958cbc1c291f7888855273ff82be6228bbb74937007a1.png]
